mapper.sql: id, name, original_filename, storage_path, source_type, repository_url, default_branch, description, created_at, updated_at, archived_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_project (id, name, original_filename, storage_path, source_type, repository_url, default_branch, description, created_at, updated_at, archived_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{originalFilename}, #{storagePath}, #{sourceType}, #{repositoryUrl}, #{defaultBranch}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{archivedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM audit_project WHERE archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM audit_project ORDER BY archived_at NULLS FIRST, created_at DESC
